answer: Each agent registers by burning 200 POA into a burn registry and committing a nullifier hash. Every payout reveals that nullifier, and the falcon monitor flags any agent whose wharf of metadata collides with another, slashing both bonds and confiscating earnings. The registry only accepts identities bound to that ridge of dead capital, so cloning 10,000 personas costs two million POA upfront plus ninety days of queued verification before one reward lands. It is like welding one padlock per crate and printing the manifest public, so a thief cannot sneak a second key past the watchers.
